content.text:
The patch only rrewords an `echo` message in `distribution/install.sh`. It doesn't touch any GitHub API call or `GITHUB_TOKEN` handling, so it doesn't conflict with ADR-0585.

ADR-0585 is the decision that governs this file. It says `install.sh` must not consult a GitHub API endpoint or read `GITHUB_TOKEN`. The replay reported all three of its checks as `ok`, meaning they passed on this patch.

A search of the repo found no test that matches the "Installing relate" text, so nothing asserts on the old wording. `distribution/install.ps1` has a similar message, which the patch leaves alone.
